input: edges describes a simple undirected star with at least three vertices and two distinct edges. Vertex labels are distinct positive safe integers; every edge joins the unique center to a leaf. All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Every individual collection length and computed allocation dimension/count fits [0,4294967295]; explicitly stated padded sizes and heap child-index arithmetic must also fit the declared exact numeric domain. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is permitted. Preconditions are not runtime-checked; allocation/resource capacity and actual completion still require qualification. Python integer inputs are plain int excluding bool; any separately declared floating probabilities are ordinary float.
mutation_aliasing: No input or edge row is modified. Only the first two rows are read and a scalar returned; the Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Only exact safe-integer equality is used. The valid-star precondition guarantees the first two distinct edges share exactly the center. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space; no scan or graph construction. Validation of the star precondition is not performed or charged as executed work. Bounds count ordinary built-in allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop, and stated hash/sort guarantees where relevant.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 256 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper definition, Solution wrapper, signatures, loops, built-in calls, comments/annotations, whitespace and terminal newline. Shared helper spelling is fully charged in each candidate, not a free library. No imports, runtime-generated implementation, external helper or hidden expansion is used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source; interface/effect parity remains unqualified.
evidence_boundary: Authored permitted dev_fit alternative outside frozen source sets. Membership was checked only against already-public cost-decomposition-v1/contract.json partition.dev_fit and the existing candidate manifest. No selected-ID source was found in public readable-v1/readable-joint-blocks-v1 source trees; therefore these effects are author-declared, not established frozen-predecessor parity. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, predecessor equivalence, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed. The mandatory isolated judge remains blocked and private original source/case/receipt material is unavailable. Syntax/static checks do not establish correctness. Independent source-bound isolated qualification must cover minimum three-vertex stars, center in either endpoint position, reordered edges, large labels and input preservation, frozen-contract reconciliation, actual return types, numerical boundaries, complete source/adapter charges and complexity. No admission or promotion follows from authoring.
